goal: Audit log review: whether security-relevant events are logged completely, protected and kept.
use: Audit log review: whether security-relevant events are logged completely, protected and kept. Use when code records sign-ins, permission changes, exports or deletions.

steps.note: List the events. Sign-in, permission change, export, deletion and admin action.
Check completeness. Flag events that produce no log entry.
Check content. Each entry needs who, what, when and the result.
Check protection. Logs must be append-only or separately stored.
Report. The events, the gaps and the fix.
